reason: The pinned checkpoint stores rope_parameters.rope_theta=1000000 in Transformers 5 format. Transformers 4.57.6 silently used its default rope_theta=10000. The first run is invalid as evidence about the correctly configured base or adapter.
repair: Translate supported default Qwen3 RoPE configuration and verify actual rotary frequencies. Reject unsupported/conflicting translations. Record effective RoPE in training and evaluation outputs.
data_and_training: All frozen data, split assignments, LoRA rank, learning rate, seed, batch size, two epochs, and development-loss checkpoint-selection rule remain unchanged. Restart from the pinned v2 weights, not the invalid adapter.
evaluation: Rerun both baseline and candidate using the corrected loader and explicitly recorded generation use_cache=true. Although saved model.config.use_cache is false, GenerationConfig already defaults to true; no cache-speedup claim is made. Three evaluation groups share the same GPU; elapsed times are not latency benchmarks.
test_exposure: Some reserved-test predictions were observed under the invalid runtime before discovering the compatibility fault. No examples, labels, thresholds, hyperparameters or checkpoint-selection criteria were changed in response. Treat this as a disclosed runtime-repair rerun, not an untouched multi-run benchmark.
screening: The original screening thresholds remain unchanged. Invalid-run weights are not a release candidate.
